subject: English Language
name: Basic 6 English Language
description: Part 1 of the Basic 6 English Language curriculum focuses on advanced Oral Language skills and Reading proficiency. It includes interpreting songs and poems, storytelling, dramatization, formal and informal conversation, and advanced reading strategies such as critical reading and summarizing.

strands.title: Oral Language (Listening and Speaking)
strands.description: Developing advanced listening and speaking skills through songs, poetry, storytelling, dramatisation, conversation, and presentation.

subStrands.title: Songs
subStrands.description: Relating songs to personal experiences and composing songs around values.

contentStandards.description: Demonstrate understanding of variety of songs

indicators.description: Relate the central messages in songs to personal experiences

exemplars.description: Sing familiar songs from cultural background.
Discuss the meaning of songs and relate to personal experiences.

indicators.description: Compose songs around values discussed

exemplars.description: Identify values in songs (e.g., love, honesty).
Compose songs around identified values in small groups.

subStrands.title: Poems
subStrands.description: Appreciating poems, discussing values, and composing poems.

contentStandards.description: Appreciate poems and other pieces of literary materials

indicators.description: Relate the central messages of poems to personal experiences

exemplars.description: Recite poems with rhythm and stress.
Discuss the central message and relate to personal experiences.

indicators.description: Discuss values in poems and talk about the importance of these values in society

exemplars.description: Identify values in poems.
Relate values to day-to-day living.

indicators.description: Compose eight-line poems

exemplars.description: Write meaningful lines on a given topic in groups.
Arrange lines to form an eight-line poem.

subStrands.title: Story Telling
subStrands.description: Connecting stories to experience and telling stories on themes.

contentStandards.description: Respond to stories

indicators.description: Make connections between texts or stories and personal experiences

exemplars.description: Retell stories using story maps.
Relate story events to personal experiences.

indicators.description: Tell stories around given themes

exemplars.description: Identify themes in stories (e.g., honesty, patriotism).
Tell stories based on selected themes.

contentStandards.description: Appreciate pieces of literary materials through dramatisation

indicators.description: Dramatise/role-play whole/parts of stories/scenes, events

exemplars.description: Discuss plot and prepare for role-play.
Perform role-plays depicting selected themes.

contentStandards.description: Appreciate key issues in stories/sketches

indicators.description: Express personal opinion about moral lessons in sketches

exemplars.description: Identify moral values in sketches.
Express personal opinions on moral lessons.

indicators.description: Write plays out of a story and perform them

exemplars.description: Convert a story into a play script.
Perform the written play.

indicators.description: Justify the central messages in sketches performed

exemplars.description: Discuss and justify key issues and lessons in sketches.

subStrands.title: Conversation
subStrands.description: Discussing objects, personalities, events, and engaging in collaborative conversation.

contentStandards.description: Explore certain culturally acceptable language for communication

indicators.description: Describe/talk about objects/personalities/events in the country and the world

exemplars.description: Discuss personalities and events using appropriate vocabulary.

contentStandards.description: Demonstrate positive listening and viewing attitudes and behaviour

indicators.description: View and listen attentively and for a sustained period

exemplars.description: Maintain eye contact and record key issues during conversation.

indicators.description: Listen and view for the entire duration of text/speech/presentation/video etc.

exemplars.description: Discuss characters and traits from texts or videos.

contentStandards.description: Use knowledge of language and communicative skills to participate in conversation

indicators.description: Engage in collaborative conversation with unfamiliar audience

exemplars.description: Discuss social issues and values in groups.

indicators.description: Demonstrate turn taking in conversation on different topics

exemplars.description: Converse following rules like listening and taking turns.

indicators.description: Ask and answer questions about key details on topics under discussion

exemplars.description: Clarify key details in group discussions.

subStrands.title: Listening Comprehension
subStrands.description: Using strategies to process meaning, analyzing text structure and content.

contentStandards.description: Use appropriate skills and strategies to process meaning from texts

indicators.description: Employ Think Aloud and visualisation strategies to make meaning from level-appropriate texts

exemplars.description: Use visualization to construct meaning from audio texts.

indicators.description: Relate the sequence of events (E.g. beginning, middle and end) stories/drama/texts

exemplars.description: Identify and list events in sequence.

indicators.description: Ask relevant questions to improve on understanding of moral lesson in text

exemplars.description: Discuss characters, setting, and moral lessons.

indicators.description: Use background knowledge to understand and build new knowledge while listening to informational text

exemplars.description: Use KWL strategy with informational texts.

indicators.description: Express own opinions about the details of texts

exemplars.description: Share opinions about text details in groups.

indicators.description: Identify the problems and solutions in texts

exemplars.description: Analyse texts for cause, effect, and solution.

indicators.description: Make simple generalisations based on the main ideas and key details of a text

exemplars.description: Form generalizations from main ideas.

subStrands.title: Asking and Answering Questions
subStrands.description: Using future expressions and question tags.

contentStandards.description: Demonstrate understanding in asking and answering questions correctly

indicators.description: Answer 'Yes' or 'No' questions correctly using the expressions that show the future

exemplars.description: Ask and answer questions about future activities.

contentStandards.description: Identify and use question tags correctly in speech

indicators.description: Use positive tags, negative tags and auxiliaries in speech

exemplars.description: Practice using question tags in pairs.

subStrands.title: Giving and Following Commands
subStrands.description: Using verbs for instructions and requests.

contentStandards.description: Explore the use of verbs in commands, instructions, requests and directions appropriately in speech

indicators.description: Create and present simple instructions or a manual on how to play a game

exemplars.description: Create and present instructions for a game.

indicators.description: Make and respond to polite requests for help from unfamiliar people

exemplars.description: Role-play polite requests with unfamiliar people.

subStrands.title: Presentation
subStrands.description: Delivering speeches and news reports with appropriate structure and delivery.

contentStandards.description: Demonstrate knowledge of spoken grammar and register

indicators.description: Demonstrate awareness of the features of spoken language e.g. the use of modal expressions to convey tentativeness

exemplars.description: Identify and use spoken language features like contractions and ellipsis.

indicators.description: Demonstrate awareness of the differences between spoken and written forms of language

exemplars.description: Compare formal (written) and informal (spoken) language.

indicators.description: Demonstrate awareness of how meaning is conveyed through appropriate pace, stress, tone – through news reporting

exemplars.description: Prepare and present news reports focusing on delivery.

contentStandards.description: Demonstrate the ability to communicate with accurate pronunciation and appropriate intonation

indicators.description: Speak at a good pace and with expression

exemplars.description: Make short speeches using appropriate voice quality.

indicators.description: Read aloud clearly, at a good pace and with expression

exemplars.description: Read short texts and speeches aloud.

contentStandards.description: Plan and present information and ideas for a variety of purposes

indicators.description: Research and deliver speeches on given informational topics

exemplars.description: Research and plan speeches on selected topics.

indicators.description: Draw on prior knowledge to identify subject matter and organisational structure of speech

exemplars.description: Identify roles and structure in speech making.

indicators.description: Gather and select facts and ideas from one or multiple print and/ or non-print sources

exemplars.description: Generate ideas from various sources for speeches.

indicators.description: Support ideas and points of view with concrete examples to convey meaning

exemplars.description: Select facts appropriate to audience and context.

indicators.description: Identify and use the appropriate register for formal and informal contexts

exemplars.description: Identify vocabulary suitable for specific topics and contexts.

indicators.description: Elaborate on points using experiences and feelings

exemplars.description: Expand points with details and personal experiences.

indicators.description: Speak with confidence before different audiences using appropriate verbal and non-verbal cues

exemplars.description: Practice speaking with confidence using appropriate cues.

strands.title: Reading
strands.description: Developing reading skills through phonics, vocabulary, and comprehension.

subStrands.title: Phonics
subStrands.description: Reading complex word endings and multisyllabic words.

contentStandards.description: Connect sounds to letters; and blend letters/syllables in order to read and write

indicators.description: Read words with ending sounds like 'sure', 'ture' and 'tch'

exemplars.description: Read words with 'sure' (measure), 'ture' (creature), 'tch' (stretch).

indicators.description: Read ccvcc, cccvc words and multisyllabic words

exemplars.description: Read words like trust, scrap, communication.

subStrands.title: Word Families: Minimal Pairs and Common Digraphs
subStrands.description: Using minimal pairs and digraphs to decode.

contentStandards.description: Identify minimal pairs and common digraphs

indicators.description: Use common minimal pairs to decode words

exemplars.description: Identify minimal pairs (e.g., goat/coat, train/chain).

indicators.description: Use words with digraphs to make meaningful sentences

exemplars.description: Identify words with digraphs (ch, ph, sh) and use them in sentences.

contentStandards.description: Identify and use diphthongs to decode texts

indicators.description: Use words with centering diphthongs to make meaningful sentences

exemplars.description: Use words with centering diphthongs (e.g., fear, prepare, pure) in sentences.

subStrands.title: Blends and Consonant Clusters
subStrands.description: Using blends and clusters to read multisyllabic words.

contentStandards.description: Identify and use consonant blends and clusters in reading

indicators.description: Orally produce three-syllable words by blending sounds, including consonant blends

exemplars.description: Identify and list words with blends (e.g., black, brush, stone).

indicators.description: Use the spelling-sound correspondences for common consonant digraphs

exemplars.description: Establish rules for spelling words with digraphs (ch, sh, gh).

subStrands.title: Vocabulary

contentStandards.description: Understand word meanings and usages

indicators.description: Use level-appropriate content words and function words appropriately

exemplars.description: Identify content words (nouns, verbs) and function words (prepositions) in sentences.

indicators.description: Use terms: compound words, idiom, simile, synonym, antonym, prefix, suffix, phrasal verb etc.

exemplars.description: Use various vocabulary terms in spoken and written expression.

contentStandards.description: Build vocabulary

exemplars.description: Read extensively and substitute words with synonyms.

contentStandards.description: Demonstrate a rich vocabulary that supports development of skills

indicators.description: Deduce meaning of words from how they relate to one another

contentStandards.description: Use words appropriately for purpose, audience, context and culture

indicators.description: Recognise how words are formed through compounding

indicators.description: Recognise the playful use of words (jokes, riddles, puns)

exemplars.description: Use jokes and riddles in speech.

indicators.description: Use words suitable for purpose, audience, context and culture

exemplars.description: Identify key elements in writing (purpose, audience) and role play.

contentStandards.description: Process and comprehend level appropriate texts

indicators.description: Construct meaning from texts

exemplars.description: Predict text content and adjust comprehension while reading.

indicators.description: Note and recall main ideas in sequence

exemplars.description: Use SQ3R strategy to recall ideas.

indicators.description: Scan/skim for details

exemplars.description: Create mental images and answer questions eliciting judgment and personal response.

contentStandards.description: Demonstrate understanding of the use of words and phrases as used in the text

contentStandards.description: Construct meaning from text read

subStrands.title: Fluency

indicators.description: Read grade-level text with meaning
